category_edits.rationale: Across all four categories, gentler training-frequency scaling may preserve useful frequent-item context. Retain mean-one normalization, clipping, unseen/padding values and the existing projected log-frequency feature. Existing checkpoint buffers and strict predictor loading preserve the revised scalars without architecture changes.

response.change_summary: Weaken frequency-based history scaling for all four HSTU category models and enforce the supplied data directory. Existing checkpoint and predictor support restores the revised feature values; learned modules, readout, loss and optimizer remain unchanged.
